sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Long-Haul Bonded Highway Freight Transport under TIR Carnets

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: France (unitary national jurisdiction; no sub-state corporate registry distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Napoleonic Code; dualistic judicial order with Cour de cassation and Conseil d'État)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: TFEU Articles 49–55 (freedom of establishment) and Articles 56–62 (services); Directive 2005/36/EC in respect of regulated professional competences
France–Japan BIT of 14 October 2018 (in force 1 December 2018)
France–China BIT of 30 May 1984 (continuity confirmed during EU-China CAI negotiation)
France–Republic of Korea BIT of 28 March 1977
EU–Singapore Investment Protection Agreement (IPA, 2019, in force)

DTAAs and social security instruments in the operating corridor: France–Germany (1959/1967), France–Belgium (1931/1967), France–Netherlands (1973/1980), France–Luxembourg (1958/2019), France–Switzerland (1966/1998)
TIR Convention of 14 November 1975 (UN/ECE) and CMR Convention of 19 May 1956 — treaty-level rights and obligations inherent to the licensed long-haul bonded road transport model

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier - CMF): Articles L561-1 to L561-50 (AML/CTF obligations); Article L561-2-2 (UBO definition) and L561-2-3 (UBO declaration and penalties); Décret n° 2016-567 of 11 May 2016 (UBO register filing rules, as amended); Directive (EU) 2015/849 and Directive (EU) 2018/843 as transposed; LOI n° 2024-364 of 22 April 2024 (new transparency regime and UBO access restrictions); French Commercial Code (Code de commerce) Articles L210-2 and R123-166 (registry and Kbis); Code pénal Articles 324-1 et seq. (money laundering offences); TRACFIN instructions on PEP and suspicious transaction reporting.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Private_Internal — UBO declarations are filed with INPI (Registre National des Entreprises). Following CJEU C-37/20 and C-601/20 (22 November 2022) and LOI n° 2024-364, the UBO register is no longer publicly accessible; access is granted only to TRACFIN, ACPR, courts and law enforcement, and to obliged entities demonstrating a legitimate interest in customer due diligence. Nominee/shareholder arrangements are not prohibited but must be disclosed; the beneficial owner behind any legal entity shareholder is pierced under the same 25% rule.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the corporate constitution (statuts/memorandum and articles) of every non-French corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or notary in the shareholder's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (1961 Convention) — France accepts apostilles; consular legalization only if the issuing state is not a Hague member

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing / certificate of incumbency (extrait de registre equivalent) for each non-French corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country company registry (e.g., registrar or UBO register authority)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the passport of each shareholder, intended manager (gérant) and every UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary or diplomatic/consular office of the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille on the notarial certification; consular legalization where apostille unavailable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill issued within the last 3 months) of the intended manager and each natural-person UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or municipal authority of the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy; apostille only where the registry or bank expressly requests it (discretionary)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Criminal record extract (extrait de casier judiciaire or equivalent police clearance) of the intended transport manager and gérant
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Ministry of Justice or police authority of the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille, required for the honorability assessment under EU Regulation (EC) 1071/2009 Article 6 and Code des transports L3211-5

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney appointing the French incorporation agent or mandated legal counsel (mandat de représentation)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary of the country of origin

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening against: (i) French freezing lists FRO (gel des avoirs) under CMF L562-1 to L562-15 administered by DG Trésor with ACPR enforcement; (ii) EU consolidated financial sanctions, inclusive of EU Reg. 269/2014, 833/2014 and the road transport prohibitions of EU Reg. 2022/576 affecting Russian and Belarusian hauliers and freight forwarding; (iii) UN Security Council sanctions regimes (Res. 1267/1989, 2231, 2664 and successors); (iv) OFAC SDN list and US sanctions, because the target payment rails include USD SWIFT wires and fuel-card clearing; and (v) national PEP registers and TRACFIN guidance under Directive (EU) 2015/849 Article 3(9). Screening must cover the applicant entity, each shareholder, each UBO, the gérant and the transport manager; results must be evidenced in the CDD file and refreshed every 90 days during the pre-incorporation phase and at least annually thereafter. Any positive hit triggers an enhanced due diligence (EDD) hold and, where required, a déclaration de soupçon to TRACFIN.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: INPI — Registre National des Entreprises (RNE) via the electronic one-stop shop 'guichet-entreprises.fr'; name pre-reservation directly with INPI (inpi.fr) with supplementary pre-validation of conflicting denominations and trademarks through Infogreffe and the greffe du tribunal de commerce.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: No statutory obligation that the corporate name itself be in French; a Latin-script name is acceptable, but the SARL statuts must be drafted in French, the RNE record carries the exact registered string, and a French transliteration of the corporate purpose must be stated so that third parties can assess the activity. The name must be lawful, non-misleading, observed in the RNE/Greffe calendars, contain no false reference to public authorities, and comply with Article L210-2 of the French Commercial Code. Surnames of persons may be used only with consent or under the rules of the Registre National des Entreprises.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: État / République / France used in a way implying official status
Notaire / Avocat / Huissier and titles of regulated professions
Fondé de pouvoir / Mandataire judiciaire / Expert-comptable
Communauté européenne / Union européenne / EURO (official bodies)
Transport public de personnes or similar regulated transport expressions
TIR / IRU / Carnet TIR (protected marks of the IRU guarantee chain; require prior affiliation)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: INPI issues the name decision within approximately two working days. On rejection, the applicant must: (1) review the stated grounds; (2) amend the name by adding a distinctive discriminating element (activity descriptor, personal name, trademark, or geographic qualifier) and re-file through the same portal; (3) if rejection is grounded on a third-party trademark, negotiate a coexistence letter or concurrently file an INPI trademark application in class 39 (transport, trucking, TIR) to secure future use; (4) request an administrative review from INPI within 30 days of the rejection notice; (5) if the refusal is contested as arbitrary, apply in interim proceedings (référé) before the President of the Tribunal judiciaire under Article R123-160 of the Commercial Code for an order compelling registration; and (6) as a fallback, incorporate under a different RNE identifier and later request a rectification of the registered name, or hold the commercial name as a registered trademark and use it as a d/b/a (nom commercial). The INPI reservation cannot be extended; after expiry of the 84-day window the application must be re-filed.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Partially permitted for the statutory seat through a commercial domiciliation agreement under Article L123-11-1 of the Commercial Code; the agreement must be written, performed during business hours and effective for at least three months, renewable. Strictly prohibited as the sole operational location for the EU licence communautaire: DREAL requires a permanent and genuine 'centre d'exploitation' (stable establishment) under Article L3211-1 of the Transport Code and Article 5(b) of EU Reg. 1071/2009, with physical parking, equipment and complete operating records available on-site; a pure virtual office will fail the substance test.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High (quantified at approximately 85% within the first 12 months). DREAL performs systematic on-site verification of the establishment before first issuance of the licence communautaire and thereafter conducts unannounced joint controls with the gendarmerie, customs (TIR) and the traffic inspectorate. The registered office must retain original transport documents, loading registers, trip records and TIR Carnets at the operating centre, not at the domiciliation address.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: INPI company name pre-reservation (réservation de nom) and RNE availability search
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff set by INPI (normally EUR 0 for search; pre-reservation handling and certified screenshot EUR 40–50)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registration of the SARL through the Guichet unique — formalité de création (RNE dossier)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI (with allocated share of greffe fee)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory INPI tariff of EUR 79.44 for the electronic registration formalité

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Mandatory legal announcement in a legal gazette (annonce légale) prior to registration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Journal d'annonces légales (JAL) authorized by the Préfecture
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory cap and prevailing JAL market rate (EUR 180–220 per insertion)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Extrait Kbis issuance (initial registry extract of the new legal entity)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed registry fee benchmark under Article R123-160 of the Commercial Code (EUR 35–45)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO declaration (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs) filed concurrently with registration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Integrated in the registration formalité; statutory penalties for omission up to EUR 7,500 (natural person) / EUR 37,500 (legal person) under CMF L561-2-3

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial domiciliation agreement — minimum one-year service
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed domiciliation company (société de domiciliation) or law firm in Paris / authorized city
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark (EUR 450–800 per year excluding mail handling)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Application to DREAL for the EU licence communautaire (transport routier de marchandises)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: DREAL (Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory administrative fee under the Transport Code (EUR 200–450 per application including control of the establishment)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificate of professional competence (attestation de capacité professionnelle) examination for the transport manager
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: CCIR / CNFPT / competent chamber recognized for CAP transport routier de marchandises
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing examination and certification market tariff (EUR 400–700 plus issuance)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille bundle for foreign corporate documents — 3 apostilles (statuts, good standing, power of attorney)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cour d'appel greffe général (France) or the competent authority of the issuing state
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Hague Apostille Convention 1961 fixed administrative fee (approximately EUR 15–30 per document, varying by issuing state)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Sworn translations (traductions assermentées) of constitutional, criminal record and address documents into French
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Expert translator sworn before the Cour d'appel (e.g., Paris)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market tariff per page (EUR 35–60 per page plus administration)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Initial TIR Carnet batch (6 carnets) and admission deposit to the national guaranteeing association
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: National TIR guaranteeing association (FNTR / TLF) in the IRU guarantee chain
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: IRU membership and carnet tariff (EUR 10–35 per carnet plus EUR 200–300 guarantee deposit, refundable)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Financial capacity certificate / bank guarantee for the transport hector (€9,000 first vehicle + €5,000 per additional vehicle)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Commercial bank or insurance company issuing the guarantee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing bank guarantee arrangement fee (0.5–2.5% of guaranteed amount, administrative minimum)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of French SARL statuts (articles of association) and corporate governance minutes by an avocat
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Avocat au Barreau de Paris / law firm engaged
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark (fixed fee EUR 1,800–2,800 for standard SARL with cross-border shareholder structures)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Optional notarial certification of share capital subscription (not statutorily required for SARL)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing notarial ancillary fee benchmark (EUR 100–150 per attestation)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Initial PEP / OFAC / UN / FRO sanctions screening of applicant, shareholders, UBOs and managers on licensed databases
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed compliance data provider (e.g., LSEG World-Check, Dow Jones) or screening-as-a-service
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market subscription and per-screen benchmark, including audit trail export

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 for the Société à Responsabilité Limitée; implementing provisions of Decree No. 2007-296 in Articles R.223-1 et seq.; RCS registration formalities under Articles R.123-1 et seq.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Commercial Court Registry) acting as the competent office for the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), receiving filings through the Centre de Formalités des Entreprises/Guichet Unique at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statuts (articles of association) and the duly completed incorporation application (dossier d'immatriculation au RCS) submitted electronically via the Guichet Unique, yielding the Extrait Kbis upon registration
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital is required for an SARL under Article L.223-2 C. com.; capital is freely set by the members, must be fully subscribed, and cash contributions shall be deposited in escrow with a bank, Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations, or notary pending registration, then released to the legal representative upon issuance of the Kbis.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, by the undersigned members of the Société à Responsabilité Limitée, that: (1) the initial share capital of €1,000, divided into 100 shares of €10 each, be and is hereby fully subscribed and the statutory cash contribution deposit certificate, issued in accordance with Article L.223-7 C. com., is accepted; (2) the registered office is hereby fixed at the address stated in the Statuts, and such address is approved as the company's statutory seat; (3) Mr./Ms. [Full Name] is appointed Gérant, with sole authority to bind the company, and is further authorized to complete filings, customs and TIR formalities. This resolution is effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and execution of the articles of association (Statuts)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Members/shareholders; optional notarization by a French notary (notaire) in the department of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare French-compliant articles of association specifying the corporate name, purpose (including TIR bonded road freight transport), registered office, share capital, division of shares, shareholder details, manager (Gérant), and decision-making rules. All shareholders must sign each page. If contributions in kind are made, obtain a statutory auditor's report (commissaire aux apports) unless an exemption applies; cash-only contributions do not require notarial execution.
required_dossiers: Draft Statuts (private deed)
Valid passports or official IDs of each shareholder
Proof of residential address for each shareholder
Statement of share subscription and ownership split
Contribution report (if apports en nature)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any substantive omissions or inconsistencies with mandatory legal provisions and have all members re-sign; if the Guichet Unique raises a query, amend the Statuts and resubmit through the same filing portal with a cover explanation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Blocking and deposit of cash contributions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Qualified bank established in France, Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations (CDC), or French notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary blocked account (compte bloqué) in the name of the 'société en formation', deposit the full cash subscription amount, and obtain the certificate of deposit (attestation de blocage de fonds) addressed to the future company. The funds may not be withdrawn before registration is completed.
required_dossiers: Bank account opening application for the société en formation
Executed Statuts
Cash deposit or wire transfer evidence
Attestation de blocage de fonds issued by the depositary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the deposit certificate is missing or rejected, provide disaggregated source-of-funds evidence or re-issue the blocked funds certificate from the depositary before filing; allow a one-off extension of the escrow period if necessary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Legal publication of the notice of incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Approved legal gazette (Journal d'Annonces Légales) in the territorial department of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft and deliver the notice of incorporation (avis de constitution) to a duly approved legal gazette, including the corporate name, legal form, registered office, share capital, corporate object, identity of the Gérant, court of the RCS, and designated dates. Obtain the publisher's attestation de parution.
required_dossiers: Signed Statuts or formal extract for the notice
Text of the proposed avis de constitution
Payment confirmation to the legal gazette
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the published notice is defective or incomplete, arrange a corrected republication without delay and ensure the retraction appears in the original gazette; preserve the publisher's receipt and the corrected attestation for the RCS filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing application with the Guichet Unique and RCS registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet Unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) as front-end; Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce back-end for the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the standard electronic formation form (M0) on the Guichet Unique, attach the signed Statuts, the attestation de parution, the attestation de blocage de fonds, identity documents, manager consent and criminal record certificate, and beneficial ownership declaration. Pay the prescribed greffe fee online, obtain the filing acknowledgment, and await review by the Greffe, which issues the Extrait Kbis upon acceptance.
required_dossiers: Form M0 / online electronic declaration
Executed Statuts
Attestation de parution from the legal gazette
Attestation de blocage de fonds from the depositary
Identity and residence proof of the Gérant
Certificate of no criminal conviction (casier judiciaire) for the Gérant
Beneficial ownership declaration (déclaration de bénéficiaires effectifs)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to prefectorial or greffe queries within the statutory 15-day period with corrective documentation; if registration is refused, apply to the President of the Commercial Court for an order compelling registration or reinstate the application after curing the identified grounds.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-registration administrative and statutory number activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INSEE (SIREN/SIRET), URSSAF, local tax office, French Customs (EORI), and DREETS/Greffe for continued compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon receipt of the Extrait Kbis, verify the SIREN and SIRET numbers and the NAF/APE code. Register the company with URSSAF for social security, with the competent tax office for corporation tax, and with French Customs for an EORI number if cross-border TIR operations will commence. Open the definitive corporate bank account and file any completion formalities regarding the manager and registered office.
required_dossiers: Extrait Kbis
Management acceptance document (acte de nomination du Gérant)
Copy of the Statuts
Manager identification and proof of address
Customs authorization application for EORI registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SIREN/SIRET is not issued in the expected timeframe, contact the Guichet Unique or INSEE via written rectification portal; for incorrect classification, use the correction procedure of the Institut and for customs, file a corrective declaration through SOPRANO or the customs EORI desk.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL) – Transport and Logistics Department, under the Ministry for Ecological Transition and Territorial Cohesion; TIR Carnet accreditation is issued by the Chamber of Commerce and Industry (CCI France) acting as the national issuing and guaranteeing association authorized by the IRU.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licence communautaire de transport routier de marchandises (Community Licence for the carriage of goods by road) and TIR Carnet accreditation; authorization for international carriage under the TIR Convention, with an optional Autorisation de Transport International for non-EU third-country movements.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Inspection des Installations Classées pour la Protection de l'Environnement (DREAL / Ministry of Ecological Transition) under the French Environmental Code (Code de l'environnement)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from full EIA (étude d'impact) for a rolling-stock-based trucking undertaking; ancillary vehicle repair or washing facilities are classified under the ICPE registration (déclaration) regime under Rubric 2930, subject to applicable threshold assessments.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Fleet must comply with Euro 6 emission standards under Regulation (EU) 595/2009. Wastewater from workshops or vehicle wash areas must meet pre-treatment thresholds before discharge to the public sewer, including pH 6.5–8.5, COD ≤ 1,000 mg/L, BOD5 ≤ 400 mg/L, suspended solids ≤ 600 mg/L, mineral hydrocarbons ≤ 10 mg/L, and lead ≤ 0.5 mg/L; waste oil, filters, and batteries must be handled as hazardous waste under ADR and French waste regulations, with VOC-emission abatement for any coating or painting operations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification for office and warehouse premises from the appropriate departmental fire authority (SDIS), completion of structural load inspections for any docking or parking area, registration of workplaces with CARSAT, implementation of the Document Unique d'Évaluation des Risques (DUERP), periodic occupational health surveillance for drivers and mechanics, and certification of the road transport manager's professional competence as required by DREAL.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) via the Impôt Gestion Publique portal; business registration and VAT procedures are coordinated through the Guichet Unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities establishing a SARL file the statutory incorporation and registration dossier via the Guichet Unique, which transmits to the CFE/INSEE to obtain SIREN and SIRET numbers. The entity then requests a TVA intracommunautaire number by completing Form 1585-1 (normal or simplified regime) through the local Centre des Finances Publiques; for non-EU residents, a tax representative may be required under Article 326 of the CGI appendix. Inward suppliers of B2B transport services may need simplified VAT registration via Form 1550 or seek reverse-charge treatment if the customer is French VAT-registered.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: SARL is by default subject to corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés, IS). A qualifying SARL may elect, within a limited window or under specific conditions, to be taxed at the level of partners as a personal-income-tax entity (transparent regime under CGI Art. 239 and related rules). Group tax consolidation (intégration fiscale) is available for French sub-groups; hybrid mismatch elections must respect ATAD transpositions, and no US-style check-the-box election exists in French domestic law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée, TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: France imposes no de minimis registration threshold for B2B supplies by non-established taxable persons; registration is generally required for French established activities. For EU-distance sales of goods the annual cross-border EU threshold is EUR 10,000; for foreign transporters, a fixed VAT registration via Form 1585 is triggered by local operations in France, subject to the reverse charge for imported transport services.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: France mandates structured electronic invoicing (Factur-X/UBL) for domestic B2B transactions under the reform sequenced from September 2026 and 2027, with clearance through the Portail Public de Facturation (PPF) or certified dematerialisation platforms (PDP). Inbound and outbound customs goods movements under TIR require the electronic customs declaration (DELTA/E-Customs) and the TIR carnet data exchange; there is no digital stamping for road transport invoices, but real-time e-invoicing reporting and upload of transaction data to DGFiP/EU systems become mandatory on the applicable roll-out dates.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A 0% VAT rating is available for supplies of goods dispatched or transported outside the European Union by the seller or on behalf of the seller (CGI Art. 262-I), and for ancillary transport services directly linked to export of goods, including international freight by road using TIR carnets, provided the transport service is from French territory to a non-EU destination or is part of an international transit movement. The supplier must hold documentary evidence proving the goods physically left the EU within statutory timeframes and that the service is consumed outside France for export purposes.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DELTA E-express / ENS or normal export clearance)
TIR Carnet (validated exit stamp and/or electronic skate)
CMR International Consignment Note (contract of carriage evidence)
Bill of Lading or equivalent proof of delivery outside EU
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank payment proof showing the foreign counterparty settled the transaction
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating claims are heavily scrutinised by DGFiP and Customs (douane). Failure to maintain or produce the required export documentation within time limits triggers VAT clawback, interest for late payment, and an 80% penalty under Article 1729 (0) CGI for concealment or abusive use of zero-rating; deliberate false declarations may constitute tax fraud (Article 1741 CGI) and customs offences under the Code des Douanes, carrying criminal fines and potential imprisonment, together with joint liability for the tax representative and service company for the underlying unpaid tax.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France) — the French central bank and central repository for balance-of-payments statistics and foreign-exchange surveillance; the Direction Générale du Trésor (French Treasury, Ministry of Economy and Finance) administers capital-account liberalisation, foreign-investment screening and financial sanctions; the ACPR (Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution) supervises the prudential and AML conduct of banks and payment institutions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France is a founding member of the euro area, and the euro is fully and freely convertible. Both capital-account and current-account items are unrestricted: Article 63 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union guarantees the free movement of capital between Member States, and France applies the OECD Code of Liberalisation of Capital Movements without exception for direct investment, profit repatriation, loan servicing or trade settlements. No exchange-control permit is required for a non-resident shareholder to inject equity into a French SARL, nor for the SARL to remit dividends, interest or royalties abroad. The practical constraints are documentary and prudential rather than convertibility-based: (i) all capital injections must pass through the regulated banking channel and are subject to mandatory UBO verification under Directive (EU) 2015/849 as transposed in the Code monétaire et financier; (ii) cross-border transactions reaching or exceeding EUR 50,000 trigger a Banque de France balance-of-payments declaration filed by the instructing credit institution under the Arrêté of 5 August 2015; (iii) dividend remittances to non-resident corporate shareholders attract a 25% French withholding tax unless reduced to 0% for EU/EEA parents meeting the Parent-Subsidiary Directive conditions (a holding of at least 5% for at least two years with a valid tax-residence certificate), or otherwise lowered by an applicable double-tax treaty; (iv) the TIR trucking model must remain compliant with EU restrictive measures — no conversion facility or banking channel can legitimise a sanctioned corridor to or through Russia, Belarus or other black-listed territories. Income invoiced in USD, GBP or CHF is freely receivable and may be retained in foreign-currency accounts in France, but physical cash entering or leaving French borders in excess of EUR 10,000 must be declared to French Customs under Regulation (EU) 2018/1672.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory surrender requirement and no mandatory conversion ratio for export receipts in France. The exchange-control regime was fully liberalised in 1990, and a French-resident exporter may keep the entirety of its foreign-currency proceeds in a French compte en devises, use them for payments to third countries, or convert them into euro at any time without penalty. The discipline that replaces surrender is reporting: (i) each transfer of funds with non-residents of EUR 50,000 or more must be tagged with a standard Banque de France nature-of-payment code, and the bank files the balance-of-payments declaration within the statutory deadlines; (ii) movements of goods within the EU are declared through the déclaration d'échanges de biens (DEB), while customs exports are supported by the DAU export declaration; (iii) TIR Carnet operations require discharge at the French customs office of destination within the time-limit set by customs, normally no more than 30 days, otherwise the international TIR guarantee chain is activated as a decisive customs debt; (iv) fuel, tolls and operational disbursements paid outside France in non-euro currencies are ordinary current-account transactions and require no prior authorisation, only proper accounting and VAT reporting.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: BNP Paribas S.A. — French Tier-1 universal bank with the largest corporate banking and trade-finance franchise
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational professional account (compte professionnel), blocked capital escrow account for incorporation (compte de consignation), multi-currency sub-accounts, SWIFT MT103/MT700 capabilities, fuel-card clearing and short-term working-capital lines

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Société Générale S.A. — Tier-1 French universal bank with strong transaction banking and FX forward product lines
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational account, capital escrow account, change-à-terme forward FX facilities, documentary credit issuance (UCP 600), cash-pooling with foreign group accounts, and dedicated transport-sector relationship desk

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: LCL S.A. (Crédit Lyonnais, Groupe Crédit Agricole) — national branch footprint strong among SMEs and haulage fleets
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational account, professional package with fuel-card and toll-transponder settlement, payroll SEPA flows, and overdraft seat for working-capital peaks

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: BRED Banque Populaire (BPCE Group) — regional cooperative bank with significant freight and cross-border merchant clientele
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational account, seasonal overdraft facilities, transport invoice discounting, and access to the BPCE trade-finance network for standby letters of credit

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: HSBC Continental Europe S.A. — Paris-quoted wholesale bank with useful link to Asian and Anglo-Saxon correspondent circuits
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational account mainly for multi-currency corridors and treasury concentration with foreign subsidiaries, but with reduced French SME coverage after the 2021-2023 footprint retrenchment

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: MEDIUM as a secondary collections and disbursement rail, LOW as the single treasury spine. An ACPR-licensed Electronic Money Institution (EMI) or payment institution passporting under Directive (EU) 2015/2366 (PSD2) can lawfully open a professional payment account, provide a French IBAN, execute SEPA credit transfers, direct debits, and sponsor-bank SWIFT operations, and issue commercial business cards for driver expenses. The legal constraints are severe for a TIR trucking entity: (i) an EMI cannot grant credit, therefore no overdraft, factoring, import/export documentary credits, TIR customs bonds or fleet finance can be provided; (ii) funds held with an EMI are e-money, not bank deposits, so they are not covered by the French deposit-guarantee scheme applicable to credit institutions; (iii) EMIs cannot issue customs guarantees or TIR Carnet guarantee instruments — only licensed insurers and credit institutions can stand behind the TIR guarantee chain; (iv) most mainstream EMIs apply restrictive usage policies and reject high-frequency freight invoice turnover or cash-receipt patterns without documentary evidence, and many cannot settle the specialised fuel-card clearing networks operated by DKV, UTA or Eurotoll; (v) from 17 January 2025 the Digital Operational Resilience Act (Regulation (EU) 2022/2554) imposes mandatory ICT-resilience obligations on payment institutions, and the entity should verify the EMI's compliance certificate. The practical blueprint is therefore to keep BNP Paribas or Société Générale as the principal clearing and credit relationship and to use a reputable EU EMI only for tactical expense-card and fast-disbursement workflows.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: French statutory law does not impose a universal in-branch interview. Article R561-14 et seq. of the Code monétaire et financier expressly permits non-face-to-face due diligence when accompanied by reinforced verification measures, such as qualified electronic signature, official digital identity verification, QR-coded register extracts and corroboration from regulated sources. In practice, however, every Tier-1 French bank conditions the opening of a SARL professional account on at least one physical meeting of the gérant (legal manager) at a French branch, and often on a second interview at the corporate seat or domiciliation address; video-identity onboarding is accepted for the second account after the first physical contact. For the blocked capital escrow account, physical or notarially authenticated identification is de facto mandatory because the bank must countersign the capital-deposit attestation (attestation de dépôt des fonds) required by the RCS registration procedure. A non-resident gérant may be represented by a power of attorney only after the initial identity verification has been completed, with the power of attorney apostilled and accompanied by a sworn French translation; a remote-only opening for the first operational account is not reliably achievable with the largest French banks. The account-opening file must include the projet de statuts, the RCS Kbis extract (or the constitution file before registration), proof of the French professional address (a signed lease, a commercial domiciliation agreement, or a garage/parking lease evidencing substance), the UBO declaration, and certified identity documents of all directors and shareholders holding above the statutory thresholds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctioned-route exposure — any TIR itinerary touching or transiting EU-sanctioned territories (Russia, Belarus, occupied territories) or counterparties on the EU consolidated financial-sanctions list
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Output of automated sanctions screening with no unresolved hits; signed trip manifests and CMR consignment notes showing lawful corridors; TIR Carnet numbers with customs office codes and discharge stamps; GPS or Eurotoll transponder traces for each border crossing; the commercial contract chain for each client; an internal sanctions compliance policy approved by the gérant; and, where relevant, a written certification that no listed dual-use goods or advanced-technology items are carried. Any actual sanctioned leg will trigger an immediate account freeze and escalation to TRACFIN by the bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque UBO structure — non-EU shareholder or ultimate beneficial owner, multi-layer corporate stack, nominee shareholding appearance, or absence of an RCS beneficiary register filing
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: The registre des bénéficiaires effectifs (UBO register) filed with the RCS and reflected in the Kbis extract; a corporate organigram covering every layer up to the natural persons; apostilled certificate of good standing from the parent registry; certified passports of all natural persons holding 25% or more; board minutes approving the French investment; source-of-wealth evidence such as audited group accounts, bank references and asset statements; and a written declaration on the absence of nominees.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity invoice turnover without fleet substance — large volumes of freight-broker payments or cash receipts from drivers, which may trigger suspicion of money laundering or tax fraud under CMF Article L561-15
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Fleet registration file listing every tractor and trailer under the SARL SIRET number with the French certificat d'immatriculation; driver identity files and employment contracts; TIR Carnet stock control log with customs discharge stamps per trip; a complete fuel-card invoice archive from DKV or UTA; subcontract agreements for sub-carriers; a written anti-cash policy and proof that all driver settlements are made by bank transfer; and customs transit documents for the bonded cargoes.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts filing (Dépôt des comptes annuels)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Commercial Court Registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 7 months after fiscal year-end (e.g., by 31 July for a 31 December year-end); the annual general meeting approving the accounts must be held within 6 months after year-end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing may be sanctioned by a court penalty up to EUR 10,000; persistent failure (two consecutive years) can lead to adminstrative strike-off and removal from the company register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Liasse fiscale, form 2065-SD)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a 31 December year-end: filed electronically by the second business day after 1 May; for any other fiscal year-end: within 3 months of the closing date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late return attracts a 10% penalty if filed within 3 months of the due date, 20% after that, 40% beyond 6 months; delay interest at 0.20% per month applies until full payment. For intentional concealment, the penalty can rise to 1.5x of the tax due.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual direct local economic tax (Cotisation Foncière des Entreprises – CFE) declaration and payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGFIP via the local Public Finance Centre (SIE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: New businesses or material changes must be declared by 12 May on the year of event; annual payment is required before 15 December of the taxation year; if the tax exceeds EUR 3,000, prepayment instalments are due in June and December.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to pay before 31 December triggers a 10% late-filing penalty plus interest at 0.20% per month; intentional omission increases the penalty to 40%; unpaid CFE can result in enforced collection and blockage of the company’s fiscal clearance certificate.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A SARL must appoint a statutory auditor (Commissaire aux Comptes) if it exceeds at least two of the following three thresholds at the balance sheet date: total assets > EUR 4,000,000; net turnover (excl. VAT) > EUR 8,000,000; average permanent employees > 50. Mandatory audit can also be triggered by parent-company control, obligations of the French Commercial Code for certain regulated activities, or a court order requested by shareholders holding at least 1/10 of the capital.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général) codified by ANC Regulation 2014-03, incorporated into the Commercial Code. IFRS is required only for consolidated accounts of listed groups; statutory accounts of a French SARL are prepared under French GAAP and converted into the fiscal liasse for the tax return.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under French law (art. L.561-49 to L.561-51 of the Monetary and Financial Code), the beneficial-owner declaration is filed with the RCS at incorporation and must be updated within 30 days of any change in beneficial ownership. There is no annual standalone UBO re-filing obligation; however, an annual internal compliance review is required to verify the register’s accuracy. Any transfer of shares must be recorded immediately in the share-transfer register, and the UBO declaration updated if the transfer changes the identity or percentage of beneficial ownership.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (registre des mouvements de titres)
Register of Directors and Managerial Decisions (registre des décisions du gérant)
Minute Book (registre des procès-verbaux d'assemblées générales)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 25% standard rate; R&D tax credit (up to 30% of eligible expenses); accelerated depreciation; possible reduced rates under specific regimes for innovation or export activities

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 2065 (Déclaration de résultat) via impots.gouv.fr electronic filing portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 3 months after fiscal year-end (e.g. May 15 for calendar year-end FY)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Revenue from sales of goods and services
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only French-source income for non-residents

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductions for costs, depreciation, and personnel
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Allowable expenses must be economically linked to French operations

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty 0.75% per month of tax due (capped at 10%); 0.2% monthly interest on unpaid tax; criminal sanctions for willful non-filing

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Submit TRC (Traitement de la Résidence Contractuelle) application to French tax authorities with supporting documents to claim reduced or zero WHT
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 0% under many treaties (e.g. France-US 0%); Interest: 0% under most treaties (e.g. France-US 0%)

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: €50 million annual turnover for Local File; €750 million consolidated revenue for Master File
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Economic Substance Regulations require companies to have adequate physical presence, employees, and core income-generating activities in France for tax purposes; non-compliance can lead to denial of deductions or recharacterization

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Willful under-declaration of taxable income or false statements in tax return
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalty: up to 5 years imprisonment and fine up to 80% of evaded tax (or higher in aggravated cases); civil restitution of evaded amounts
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may face personal criminal liability, including imprisonment and fines; possible disqualification from management positions

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to prepare or maintain adequate TP documentation or using non-arm's length prices
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fine up to €10 million or 5% of turnover; potential adjustment of taxable base by tax authorities
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors can be held personally liable for fraudulent TP practices leading to tax fraud

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to withhold or remit WHT on dividends, interest, or royalties to non-resident entities
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: WHT non-remittance penalty equal to the withheld tax plus interest; possible criminal sanctions for willful evasion
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally liable for unpaid WHT; risk of imprisonment for fraudulent withholding

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company or Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a French entity without sufficient economic activity or substance to justify tax residency
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Denial of tax deductions, recharacterization of income, fines up to €10 million, possible criminal prosecution
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally prosecuted for abuse of law or tax fraud; potential prison sentences and asset freezes
